  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. EXAMINATIONS - JANUARY 2024  
  SUBJECT: ECE 1071 / ECE-1071 - BASIC ELECTRONICS  
  
  Answer ALL questions.  
  Missing data may be assumed.  
  
  BASIC ELECTRONICS [ECE 1071]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1A)          Draw the VI characteristics of the Silicon diode. Explain the different types of  
  breakdown mechanisms in a PN junction diode.                                                (4)  
  
  1B)          If a Silicon diode has a reverse saturation current of 20nA at 27º C, calculate the reverse  
  current, forward current and dynamic resistance at 40ºC when the diode is forward           (3)  
  biased at 0.7V  
  
  1C)          Obtain an expression for the drain current of MOSFET in terms of 'VGS', 'VDS' and the  
  dimension of the device. Also, plot the VI characteristics of the device indicating all the (3)  
  salient features on it.  
  
  2A)          Explain the operation of half wave rectifier with neat circuit and waveform. Derive an  
  equation for Vdc, Vrms and efficiency.                                                      (4)  
  
  2B)          A full wave bridge rectifier with capacitor filter has Vm = 8V, RL = 100Ω, C = 1000µF  
  and f = 50Hz. Calculate the ripple factor and the DC output voltage.                        (3)  
  
  $$2C)          A Zener regulator circuit has VZ = 20 V, IZmax = 60 mA, RS= 220Ω and RL= 1.2kΩ.$$  
  Calculate the range of input voltage for which output will remain constant. Draw the        (3)  
  circuit of a Zener voltage regulator and label all the components.  
  
  3A)          i) Represent (0111)2 in the following codes:  
  a) Gray code b) (7, 4) even parity Hamming code                                             (4)  
  ii) Perform (13.25)10 - (26.75)10 using 1's complement method.  
  
  3B)          Draw the circuit diagram of an OPAMP inverting amplifier and derive the expression for  
  an output voltage. Given RF=20kΩ, R1=4kΩ and the dc supply voltage is ±15V.  
  Calculate and plot the output voltage with respect to the input, if an input applied is 3sin (3)  
  (2π1000t) Volt.  
  
  3C)          Design an adder circuit using two OPAMP's to obtain:                                        (3)

  4A)           Explain the Full adder circuit with a neat circuit diagram and truth table. Also obtain  
  (45)10-(87)10 using 2's complement method.                                                 (4)  
  
  4B)           Design a 2 bit Ripple up counter using positive edge triggered JK flipflop. Also sketch  
  the timing diagram for the same.                                                           (3)  
  
  4C)           Explain the operation of positive edge triggered SR flipflop using NAND gate with a  
  neat circuit diagram and truth table. Also Realize D flipflop using SR flipflop.           (3)  
  
  5A)           Define Frequency Modulation (FM). Given a FM signal VFM(t) = 20 cos [2Π108t+5  
  sin(2Π15000t)], Calculate Carrier frequency, Modulating frequency, Frequency               (4)  
  deviation and Bandwidth using Carson's rule.  
  
  5B)           Define sampling theorem. For an analog signal, x(t)=3cos100πt. Determine the  
  minimum sampling rate required to reconstruct the signal.                                  (3)  
  
  5C)           For the given binary data 1101 sketch the ASK, FSK and PSK waveforms.  
  (3)
